_doc: ADR 0026 v2 / M27 — validates the second major Sinatra plugin authoring pattern. Where sinatra_plugin_smoke covers the reopen-Base shape (older plugins; class Sinatra::Base; def ...; end), this fixture covers the canonical `Sinatra.register Module` + `helpers Module` shape that real gems (sinatra-cors, sinatra-flash, sinatra-respond_to, etc.) use. Plugin file follows the real-gem authoring conventions: a module providing `self.registered(app)` that calls `app.helpers HelpersMod` + `app.before do ...` + adds routes. App uses `register Sinatra::MetaInfo`. The vendored micro-Sinatra gained `Sinatra::Base.register` and `Sinatra::Base.helpers` (shared with sinatra_hello via `../sinatra_hello/vendor/sinatra_lite`); the real Sinatra gem provides the same surface on CRuby. Validates: (a) Module.registered(app) hook is called by register, (b) helpers Module mixes instance methods into route dispatch instances, (c) plugin-installed before-filter runs for every request, (d) plugin-installed routes work alongside app-defined routes, (e) helper methods access @ivars set by the plugin's before-filter.
name: sinatra_register_smoke
